author: Prof. Aditya Verma (rnd-head, E-011)
steering: Wave-4 learnings: (1) convex/tail-protective signals are undervalued by linear rank-IC (clean-surplus +3.04 skew, CFO/PAT +1.30) - find more; (2) momentum/trend is crowded (~1 independent bet, null-sweep proof) - ZERO momentum variants here; (3) forensic/earnings-quality is the orthogonal frontier; (4) receivables/DSO/unbilled/shareholding/estimates remain data-blocked - every construction below uses ONLY metric_norm fields verified on disk 2026-07-17 (34 uniques in MASTER_fundamentals_pit.parquet; cash-flow set + dividend payout % are ~750-firm subsets and flagged where used).
evaluation_directive: Per COMPLETENESS_CRITIC #4 (modality gap): every W5 test must report PAYOFF SHAPE (LS skew, worst-month, crash-episode conditional means per TAIL_CONVEXITY.md method) alongside rank-IC, and rank on the RECONCILED net-LS figure once queue item 5 lands. Hard gates lag+placebo only; PBO/DSR advisory (low-t rule). All candidates are NEXT-SLEEVE material on their own forward clock; the frozen 7-leg is never touched.
trials_note: Each idea = ONE base construction + at most ONE pre-registered refinement (no sweeps - H002 lesson). Log every run in trials_counter under its own family id.

hypotheses.name: Cost-elasticity discipline (anti-sticky costs)
hypotheses.mechanism: Cost-stickiness literature (Anderson-Banker-Janakiraman): most firms' costs rise with sales but do not fall with sales. Managements that actually cut costs in down-revenue years reveal operational discipline that pays off precisely in stress - a structurally CONVEX trait invisible to linear IC in calm markets.
hypotheses.construction: For each firm, over trailing 8 FYs (PIT available_date join), take all year-pairs where d_ln(sales) < 0 (min 2 such years, else NaN). Score = mean over those years of [d_ln(expenses) / d_ln(sales)] (elasticity in DOWN years; higher = costs fell with sales = disciplined). Repo sign convention: factor = z_cs(elasticity_down), long HIGH. Fields: sales, expenses. Non-financials only.
hypotheses.expected_sign: + (disciplined cost-cutters outperform, concentrated in stress months)
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: CONVEX expected: ~flat IC in expansions (down-sales years rare/irrelevant), payoff concentrated in slowdown/crash months. Pre-register the shape test: LS mean in worst-decile market months > unconditional LS mean.
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg: No leg touches cost behavior. Nearest neighbor QMJ profitability (level, not response-to-shock) - expect corr < 0.3; run corr vs all 7 before any spend.
hypotheses.why_distinct: Management-behavior-under-stress channel; not a level ratio, not an accrual, not a price signal. Nothing in 496 trials conditions on down-sales years.
hypotheses.refinement: Gate to firms with >= 3 down-sales years observed (reduces noise from single-episode estimates).

hypotheses.name: Implied borrowing cost (lender-information channel)
hypotheses.mechanism: Banks reprice credit risk before equity markets do. A firm paying an anomalously HIGH effective interest rate for its size/sector carries the lender's private negative information; anomalously LOW = certified quality. Avoiding the high-rate tail is exactly the blow-up-avoidance the Principal wants.
hypotheses.construction: implied_rate_t = interest_t / (0.5*(borrowings_t + borrowings_{t-1})); require avg borrowings/total assets >= 5% (else NaN - rate meaningless for near-zero debt). Factor = -z_cs(implied_rate residualized on ln(total assets) and sector), long LOW implied rate. Fields: interest, borrowings, total assets. Non-financials only.
hypotheses.expected_sign: + for low implied rate (cheap credit = certified safe)
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: CONVEX expected via short-leg avoidance: high-implied-rate names are the ones that gap down in credit-tightening episodes (2013 taper, 2018 IL&FS, 2022 hikes). Pre-register: bottom-quintile (expensive-credit) names' conditional crash-month return << universe.
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg: QMJ safety uses leverage LEVEL; W4F-05 (queued) uses coverage TREND (EBIT/interest). This is the PRICE of debt - the lender's assessment - a third, distinct quantity. Expect moderate corr to QMJ; must pass incremental-IC vs 8-leg.
hypotheses.why_distinct: Only signal in the program that imports ANOTHER market's information set (credit) from pure on-disk P&L/BS fields. No external data needed.
hypotheses.refinement: Winsorize implied_rate at 30% (data errors); test 2FY change in implied rate as the flow variant ONLY if level passes.

hypotheses.name: Fundamental operating leverage (low op-profit-to-sales sensitivity)
hypotheses.mechanism: Firms whose operating profit swings little per unit of sales swing (low fundamental operating leverage) suffer smaller earnings shocks in demand contractions - defensive at the CASH FLOW level, unlike price-based low-vol (whole price-defensive shelf already tested/killed).
hypotheses.construction: Over trailing 8 FYs: OLS beta of d_ln(operating profit) on d_ln(sales), firms with >= 5 valid year-pairs and operating profit > 0 in >= 6 FYs. Factor = -z_cs(beta), long LOW sensitivity. Fields: operating profit, sales. Non-financials only.
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: Mildly CONVEX expected: protection in earnings-recession months, drag in sharp recoveries (pre-register the Apr-2009-style rebound month as the known weak spot, per QMJ/BAB lesson in TAIL_CONVEXITY.md - report rebound-month exposure explicitly).
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg: Distinct from QMJ (level composite) and from killed price-low-vol/idiovol (price-based). PRIOR-ART CAVEAT: earnings-STABILITY (unconditional variance) killed/inverted (H023) - this is CONDITIONAL sensitivity to sales, a different estimand; if corr(W5-03, old earn-stability construct) > 0.6, kill immediately without further spend.
hypotheses.why_distinct: Fundamental (not price) defensiveness; conditional elasticity, not variance.

hypotheses.name: Net financial slack (fortress balance sheet, crisis-conditional)
hypotheses.mechanism: Principal's gold/cash de-risk logic applied cross-sectionally: in credit crunches, firms with net financial slack (liquid investments >> borrowings) can survive, buy distressed assets, and avoid dilution - the equity behaves like it owns an embedded option that pays in the bad state.
hypotheses.construction: slack_t = (investments_t - borrowings_t) / total_assets_t. Factor = z_cs(slack), long HIGH slack. Non-financials only (deposits/financing firms excluded). Fields: investments, borrowings, total assets.
hypotheses.expected_sign: + conditional on stress; near-zero unconditional (agency drag in bulls - see W5-05, the opposing flow signal)
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: THE explicit convexity bet of this batch: pre-register that top-quintile slack LS return in worst-decile market months and in the 2018 NBFC + 2022 episodes > +2% while unconditional IC may be ~0. If unconditional IC is negative AND stress payoff flat, kill.
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg: Partial overlap with QMJ safety (leverage) - mandatory incremental-IC vs 8-leg AND corr vs QMJ before promotion. No leg uses the investments field's asset side.
hypotheses.why_distinct: First signal in the program designed and gated on CONDITIONAL (stress-state) payoff rather than unconditional IC - directly fills COMPLETENESS_CRITIC blind spot #4.
hypotheses.refinement: Interaction gate: slack HIGH and implied borrowing cost LOW (W5-02) - only if both bases pass individually.

hypotheses.name: Treasury bloat / diworsification penalty (capital-allocation agency tell)
hypotheses.mechanism: An OPERATING firm piling incremental capital into financial investments - while core capex stalls and payout does not rise - signals promoter treasury behavior / absent reinvestment runway / cash-extraction risk. Agency channel, the flow-side mirror of W5-04's level.
hypotheses.construction: Over trailing 3 FYs: d_investments / max(d_total_assets, 0.02*total_assets_{t-3}); flag_bloat = share > 0.5 AND d_(fixed assets + cwip) / d_total_assets < 0.25 AND dividend payout % not risen (where payout available; else payout condition dropped, disclosed). Factor = -z_cs(investment share of asset growth) under those gates, long LOW bloat. Fields: investments, fixed assets, cwip, total assets, dividend payout % (partial).
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: Convex via avoidance: bloat names carry governance-event tail risk (pledge/extraction blowups). Expect payoff lumpy/episodic, not monthly-linear - report event-style conditional returns.
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg: Distinct from asset-growth anomaly (TOTAL growth level; this is the COMPOSITION of growth) and from NOA (tested, no lift - NOA nets everything; this isolates the financial-asset flow). Corr vs bs_asset_growth required first.
hypotheses.why_distinct: First capital-allocation-QUALITY (composition-of-spend) signal; nothing in the corpus asks where the marginal rupee went.

hypotheses.name: Dividend continuity under earnings stress (payout persistence)
hypotheses.mechanism: Lintner smoothing: managements set dividends they never want to cut. A firm that MAINTAINS payout through a down-EPS year is certifying cash-flow durability with its own money; a cut is a high-severity negative event. Behavioral certification, not a yield level.
hypotheses.construction: streak = consecutive trailing FYs with dividend payout % > 0; stress_hold = 1 if in the most recent FY with eps decline >= 20%, dividend per share proxy (eps * payout%/100) did NOT fall > 10%. Factor = z_cs(min(streak,10)) + stress_hold bonus (pre-set +0.5 z, not fitted). Fields: dividend payout %, eps in rs, net profit.
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: Defensive/mildly convex: payoff concentrated in flights-to-quality. Positive-skew expectation via short-leg (recent cutters) crash avoidance.
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg: AFP-style QMJ includes a payout component - check our QMJ implementation's payout leg overlap FIRST (if our QMJ build has payout, corr may be high -> kill cheap). Distinct from queued H039 shareholder yield (LEVEL of total yield; this is PERSISTENCE/behavior).
hypotheses.why_distinct: Behavioral signaling channel (management's revealed confidence), not a valuation or quality ratio.
hypotheses.data_status: buildable-limited (dividend payout % = 7,695 rows / ~750 firms - test on subset, disclose coverage like CFO/PAT leg)

hypotheses.name: Borrowed dividends (payout funded by debt) red flag
hypotheses.mechanism: A firm holding its dividend while borrowings rise and operating cash cannot cover payout+interest is round-tripping the balance sheet to keep up appearances - classic pre-blowup behavior (IL&FS-era pattern). Forensic capital-allocation penalty.
hypotheses.construction: flag = (payout% > 0) AND (borrowings_t > 1.15*borrowings_{t-1}) AND, on CF subset, (cash from operating activity < estimated dividends (net profit*payout%/100) + interest). Factor = penalty-only: -z on the composite intensity (borrowings growth x payout maintained). Fields: dividend payout %, borrowings, interest, net profit, cash from operating activity (subset).
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: Convex via short-leg avoidance; expect episodic large negatives on flagged names in credit stress. Evaluate event-style, not just monthly IC.
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg: Distinct from CFO/PAT (earnings authenticity; this is DISTRIBUTION authenticity), from issuance (equity channel), from W4-06 debt-issuance (raw debt flow without the payout interaction).
hypotheses.why_distinct: Interaction of financing and distribution decisions - a governance/forensic tell no single-field factor captures.
hypotheses.data_status: buildable-limited (full-coverage core; CFO condition on ~750-firm subset - run both with/without CFO condition as base vs refinement)

hypotheses.name: Moat proxy: OPM level x OPM stability (pricing-power persistence, 5Y horizon)
hypotheses.mechanism: Persistent high operating margin = pricing power = the coverage map's own named actionable gap (PMS #5 moat proxy, never tested). Pricing power is what protects fundamentals in downturns - a 5Y-lens quality trait distinct from ROE-style profitability.
hypotheses.construction: Over trailing 5 FYs: moat = median(opm %) - lambda*IQR(opm %), lambda=1 pre-set (not fitted). Factor = z_cs(moat), long HIGH, 5Y horizon primary (1Y secondary). Fields: opm %. Non-financials.
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: Defensive: expect bear-month protection like QMJ's decline behavior; pre-register the rebound-month giveback check (Apr-2009 pattern).
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg: Must clear incremental-IC vs QMJ (profitability overlap likely). PRIOR-ART CAVEAT: earnings-stability killed/inverted (H023) - this differs by (a) MARGIN not earnings-growth variance, (b) level x stability interaction, (c) 5Y horizon. If corr vs H023 construct > 0.6 -> kill without spend.
hypotheses.why_distinct: The one explicitly-flagged untested gap from FRAMEWORK_CATALOG (moat direction proxy); 5Y lane where only EY/dcf currently live.

hypotheses.name: Realized fundamental stress-beta (COVID-FY21 operating drawdown as a PIT trait)
hypotheses.mechanism: The best predictor of behavior in the NEXT stress is measured behavior in the LAST one. Each firm's realized operating-performance drawdown through FY2020-21 (and FY2012-13 slowdown) is a PIT-legal, price-free crash-beta - firms that kept sales/OPM through COVID are structurally defensive in a way price beta mis-measures.
hypotheses.construction: stress_resilience = 0.5*z_cs(d_ln sales FY20->FY21) + 0.5*z_cs(OPM% change FY20->FY21), computed ONCE, usable PIT only after FY21 available_date (~late 2021). Factor = z_cs(stress_resilience), long HIGH, tested on the 2022-selloff + 2024-25 windows only (honest: that is the only OOS stress data). Fields: sales, opm %.
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: Convex BY CONSTRUCTION (a stress-state trait). Honest caveat up front: n=1 training episode, ~1 partial evaluation episode - this is a PILOT for the mechanism class, graded on the 2022 window + shape, not on significance.
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg: Price-free crash-beta; distinct from killed downside-beta/idiovol shelf (price-based) and from QMJ (unconditional levels). Corr check vs QMJ required.
hypotheses.why_distinct: Episode-conditional trait modality - new estimand class for the program (fills critic #4).
hypotheses.refinement: Add FY2012-13 slowdown as a second training episode for firms with pre-2013 PIT coverage (thin - disclose).

hypotheses.name: Debt-maturity wall / refinancing risk
hypotheses.mechanism: Firms with large near-term debt maturities into a tightening cycle carry binary refinancing risk - the equity is short a put on credit conditions. Avoiding the refi-wall tail = pure convexity. Nothing on disk splits borrowings by maturity.
hypotheses.construction: BLOCKED as specified. Requires current-vs-non-current borrowings split (annual-report schedules) or NSE/exchange corporate-bond maturity data. On-disk fallback DOES NOT EXIST (borrowings is a single aggregate). Do NOT proxy with total leverage (that is QMJ's field).
hypotheses.expected_skew_convexity: Convex via avoidance (refi failures are gap-down events).
hypotheses.orthogonality_vs_7leg: Distinct axis (TERM STRUCTURE of liabilities); no leg or W4 candidate touches maturity.
hypotheses.why_distinct: Debt-maturity is the canonical un-owned credit-risk axis; complements W5-02 (price of debt) with QUANTITY-WHEN of debt.
hypotheses.priority: L (until data) - promote to H on data arrival
hypotheses.data_status: DATA-BLOCKED - add to DATA-ASKS: current/non-current borrowings split (screener 'borrowings' schedule page or AR OCR) or exchange bond-maturity file

batch_summary.mechanism_lanes: cost discipline (behavioral), credit-market information, fundamental operating leverage, balance-sheet optionality, capital-allocation composition, payout signaling, distribution forensics, pricing-power persistence, episode-conditional stress-beta, debt term structure
